annotations.text:
Direction A — "quiet paper". Warm off-white, Newsreader for screen titles over IBM Plex Sans, one deep-green accent, flat colour and hairline borders instead of heavy shadows. Red and amber are reserved entirely for deadline signalling, so category colours never fight them.

Start top-left and work right: Today, then the All list mid-planning-pass, then a task detail.

The three-pane answer to your screen-real-estate point: sidebar, list, detail side by side. The width is used without needing Kanban buckets, and editing a field never navigates you away from the list.

Bottom right is the always-visible keyboard legend.

Two low-fi alternates, in case Direction A is not the feel you want.

B — dense and utilitarian. One row per task, hard rules, tabular dates. Fits far more on screen; colder.

C — bold and high-contrast. Large type, dark ground, almost no chrome. Striking on a phone; slower to scan when the list gets long.

These are sketches, not finished screens. Say A, B or C and I will build the rest to match.
